extracted.intended_audience: State Apprenticeship Agencies (SAAs), Registration Agencies, program sponsors, employers, labor organizations, intermediaries, Office of Apprenticeship staff, and other registered apprenticeship stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Standards, definitions, metrics, and procedural requirements for registering, overseeing, and reporting on registered apprenticeship and registered CTE apprenticeship programs, and for recognition of State Apprenticeship Agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and scope (§29.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets forth labor standards to safeguard apprentices' welfare; promote formulation of quality registered apprenticeship programs across industries; bring employers, labor, education partners, and intermediaries together; ensure equitable apprenticeship opportunities for underserved communities; prescribe policies and procedures concerning registration, cancellation, deregistration, CTE apprenticeship registration, collection of apprenticeship-related data, SAA recognition, oversight and accountability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers registration and oversight tasks for OA and Registration Agencies; emphasizes inclusive access and strengthened, modernized regulations to reflect needs of modern National Apprenticeship System.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual completion rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of apprentices during a fiscal year who received a Certificate of Completion divided by the total number of exiters during the fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apprentice
rubrics_metrics.description: A worker at least 16 years of age (unless higher minimum established by law) participating in a registered apprenticeship program under subpart A covered by this part and part 30.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apprenticeship agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: A written agreement executed between an apprentice and either a program sponsor or participating employer at the beginning of the apprenticeship that satisfies §29.9 and describes terms and conditions of employment and training, as well as any subsequent contractual provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must meet §29.9 requirements (see standards of apprenticeship and apprenticeship agreement provisions elsewhere in the rule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Apprenticeship committee
rubrics_metrics.description: Persons designated by the sponsor to administer the program; may be joint (equal employer and employee representatives via bona fide collective bargaining agent) or non-joint (employer representatives, no bona fide bargaining agent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation
rubrics_metrics.description: Termination of the apprenticeship agreement by either the apprentice or sponsor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career and technical education (CTE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Organized educational activities that offer a sequence of courses providing rigorous academic content and relevant technical knowledge/skills; include competency-based or applied learning; coordinate between secondary and postsecondary programs; may include career exploration at secondary or middle grades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CTE at secondary level must align with State academic standards; may offer recognized postsecondary credentials and articulation/dual enrollment opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career pathway
rubrics_metrics.description: Combination of rigorous, high-quality education, training, and services that align with industry skill needs; prepares individuals for secondary/postsecondary options including registered apprenticeship; includes counseling and organizes services to accelerate advancement; enables attainment of secondary diploma and at least one postsecondary credential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Should align to State/regional labor market needs and support entry/advancement within occupations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of Completion
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation that a Registration Agency has determined an individual successfully completed a registered apprenticeship program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be issued in a secure digital format in addition to or instead of a physical format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of completion of registered CTE apprenticeship
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation that a Registration Agency determined an individual successfully completed a registered CTE apprenticeship program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be in secure digital format in addition to or instead of physical.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of Participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation that an apprentice has participated or is participating in a registered apprenticeship program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be issued digitally or physically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of Recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation that the Administrator has recognized National Guidelines for Apprenticeship Standards as eligible for local registration by a Registration Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be in secure digital format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation that a Registration Agency has registered an apprenticeship program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be in secure digital format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cohort completion rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of an apprenticeship cohort who receive a Certificate of Completion within 1 year of the projected completion date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When calculating, a Registration Agency must disregard cancellations of apprenticeship agreements by apprentice or sponsor that occurred during the program's probationary period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collective bargaining agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Written agreement negotiated between employer(s) and bargaining representative(s) addressing wages, hours, safety, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competency
rubrics_metrics.description: Attainment of knowledge, skills, abilities, and techniques as specified in a work process schedule approved under §29.7 and demonstrated by an appropriate on-the-job, industry-based proficiency measurement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrective action plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan developed by an SAA in consultation with OA that identifies actionable steps a State must take to address unresolved findings of noncompliance with this part or part 30.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must list specific milestones for key corrective actions and detail subsequent Department action in the event of State inaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credential rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of an apprenticeship cohort who receive an interim credential prior to program completion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registration Agencies must disregard cancellations during the probationary period when calculating credential rate.

rubrics_metrics.name: CTE apprentice
rubrics_metrics.description: A participant at least 16 years old (unless higher minimum by law) in a registered CTE apprenticeship program covered by subpart B and part 30; not an 'apprentice' for certain other statutory/regulatory provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CTE apprentice classification affects applicability of specific regulatory sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: CTE apprenticeship agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: A written agreement that complies with §29.24 and contains the terms and conditions of employment and training of the CTE apprentice.

rubrics_metrics.name: CTE apprenticeship-related instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Organized and systematic instruction designed to provide CTE apprentices knowledge of theoretical and technical subjects related to the industry skills framework; must involve curriculum approved as part of a State-approved CTE program and may include additional coursework prescribed by the sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction may be classroom-based, via electronic media, or other forms approved by the State CTE Agency and Registration Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct threat
rubrics_metrics.description: Significant risk of substantial harm to health or safety of the individual or others that cannot be eliminated or reduced by reasonable accommodation; determination must be based on individualized assessment using current medical knowledge or objective evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Factors to consider: duration of risk; nature/severity of potential harm; likelihood harm will occur; imminence of potential harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disability
rubrics_metrics.description: A physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more major life activities; a record of such impairment; or being regarded as having such an impairment.

rubrics_metrics.name: EEO (equal employment opportunity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Abbreviation for equal employment opportunity as used in this part and part 30.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EEO requirements and DEIA focus are emphasized as important aspects of the regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employer (apprenticeship context)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person or organization that employs workers and, with respect to employing apprentices, employs an apprentice during the on-the-job training component pursuant to a sponsor's approved standards and apprenticeship agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnicity (for recordkeeping and affirmative action)
rubrics_metrics.description: Has the same meaning as OMB Standards for Classification of Federal Data on Race and Ethnicity: (1) Hispanic or Latino; (2) Not Hispanic or Latino.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exit
rubrics_metrics.description: When an apprentice has ended participation in a registered apprenticeship program due to completion, transfer, or cancellation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes any Federal contract, grant, agreement, or arrangement dealing with registered apprenticeship and any Federal financial or other assistance, benefit, privilege, contribution, allowance, exemption, preference, or right pertaining to registered apprenticeship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Accounting period of OA beginning October 1 and ending September 30 of the next calendar year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genetic information
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about an individual's genetic tests, family members' genetic tests, manifestation of disease in family members, requests for/receipt of genetic services or participation in research that includes genetic services, or genetic information of a fetus or embryo; excludes sex/age or race/ethnicity not derived from a genetic test.

rubrics_metrics.name: Group program
rubrics_metrics.description: Apprenticeship program established and registered by a sponsoring organization in which one or more employers agree to participate, usually pursuant to a collective bargaining agreement or program standards adoption agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry skills framework
rubrics_metrics.description: On-the-job training outline of nationally applicable, high-quality standards of registered CTE apprenticeship validated by industry detailing required skills and competencies for CTE apprentices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution of higher education (IHE)
rubrics_metrics.description: Has the meaning given in section 101(a) of the Higher Education Act of 1965.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interim credential
rubrics_metrics.description: A recognized postsecondary credential issued in connection with participation in a registered apprenticeship program signifying attainment of competency milestones prior to program completion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be part of a career pathway toward more advanced competencies and credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intermediary
rubrics_metrics.description: Entity that assists in the provision, coordination, or support of a registered apprenticeship program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journeyworker
rubrics_metrics.description: Experienced worker who has attained proficiency in the skills and competencies required in an industry or occupation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local educational agency (LEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Has the meaning given in section 8101 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration of an apprenticeship program for Federal purposes by a Registration Agency within a particular State.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major life activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes caring for oneself, performing manual tasks, seeing, hearing, eating, sleeping, walking, standing, sitting, reaching, lifting, bending, speaking, breathing, learning, reading, concentrating, thinking, communicating, interacting with others, and working; also operation of major bodily functions (immune, organ systems, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: National Apprenticeship System
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinated efforts of OA, recognized SAAs, registered apprenticeship programs/CTE programs, employers, labor unions, business organizations, educational institutions, intermediaries, pre-apprenticeship programs, and other stakeholders implementing minimum labor standards and EEO requirements of this part and part 30.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Guidelines for Apprenticeship Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Template of apprenticeship program standards developed by national labor unions, trade or industry associations, or organizations with national scope that are recognized by OA for adaptation by affiliated sponsors for local or national registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Occupational Standards for Apprenticeship
rubrics_metrics.description: Universally available template of nationally applicable, high-quality apprenticeship standards (and related work process schedules) developed by industry stakeholders convened by OA and approved by the Administrator for occupations considered suitable for registered apprenticeship training.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Program Standards for Apprenticeship
rubrics_metrics.description: Set of standards developed and adopted by a program sponsor that are registered nationwide by OA and entitled to reciprocity of registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-compete provision
rubrics_metrics.description: Term in an apprenticeship agreement or other agreement that prohibits the apprentice from seeking or accepting employment with another employer during the registered apprenticeship program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of Apprenticeship (OA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Office within the Department's Employment and Training Administration designated by the Secretary to administer the National Apprenticeship System or its successor.

rubrics_metrics.name: On-the-job training
rubrics_metrics.description: Organized and systematic training at a workplace/job site designed to provide hands-on knowledge, skills, techniques, and competencies necessary to achieve proficiency in an occupation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participating employer
rubrics_metrics.description: An employer that employs at least one apprentice and either (1) participates in a registered program sponsored by a joint labor-management apprenticeship under a collective bargaining agreement and has adopted sponsor's standards and is employer of record; or (2) is party to a program standards adoption agreement outside collective bargaining and has adopted the sponsor's standards and is employer of record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical or mental impairment
rubrics_metrics.description: Any physiological disorder or condition affecting one or more body systems, or any mental or psychological disorder such as intellectual disability, organic brain syndrome, emotional/mental illness, or specific learning disabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-apprenticeship program
rubrics_metrics.description: Structured education and workplace training program with a documented partnership with at least one registered apprenticeship program; designed to support access and equitable participation by providing foundational knowledge and skills and hands-on introduction to competencies; provides counseling, supportive services, and may include opportunities to earn industry-recognized credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to prepare individuals who lack minimum qualifications for admission into a registered apprenticeship or registered CTE apprenticeship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrated, measurable attainment by an apprentice of relevant job skills and competencies necessary to perform at the journeyworker level in a given occupation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program review
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative review of a registered apprenticeship program conducted by a Registration Agency to assess compliance with requirements of this part and part 30.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program standards adoption agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Written agreement executed outside collective bargaining where a participating employer agrees to adopt and utilize a set of apprenticeship program standards developed by a program sponsor and registered by a Registration Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial provisional approval of programs that meet required standards for registration; after which approval may be made permanent, continued as provisional, or deregistered following a program review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as an interim status subject to program review by the Registration Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualified applicant / qualified apprentice (part 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual who, with or without reasonable accommodation, can perform the essential functions of the registered apprenticeship program for which they applied or are enrolled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Race (for recordkeeping and affirmative action)
rubrics_metrics.description: Has the same meaning as OMB Standards: White; Black or African American; Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander; Asian; American Indian or Alaska Native.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasonable accommodation
rubrics_metrics.description: Modifications or adjustments to job application process or work environment that enable a qualified applicant or apprentice with a disability to be considered for or perform essential functions and to enjoy equal benefits/privileges of apprenticeship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include making facilities accessible, job restructuring, part-time/modified schedules, reassignment, equipment acquisition/modification, adjustment of examinations/training materials, provision of qualified readers/interpreters. Determination may require an informal, interactive process to identify limitations and potential accommodations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reciprocity of registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision of local registration status by an SAA in that State for an apprenticeship program registered by another Registration Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognized postsecondary credential
rubrics_metrics.description: A credential consisting of an industry-recognized certificate/certification, a license recognized by the State or Federal Government, or an associate or baccalaureate degree.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered apprenticeship program
rubrics_metrics.description: Structured apprenticeship program registered by a Registration Agency under subpart A comprising paid, supervised on-the-job training and related instruction conveying theoretical and technical knowledge; may be eligible for student assistance under title IV of the Higher Education Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered CTE apprenticeship program
rubrics_metrics.description: Structured integrated educational and career training program admitting students who signed a CTE apprenticeship agreement approved by the Registration Agency; integrates paid on-the-job training with CTE apprenticeship-related instruction offered by a Perkins-eligible education institution; provides certificate of completion, credit hours toward postsecondary degree, and as applicable high school diploma/equivalency and advanced standing in subpart A programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration Agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Governmental agency (OA or an SAA recognized by OA) responsible for registering and overseeing apprenticeship programs and apprentices; providing technical assistance; and conducting program reviews for compliance with this part and part 30.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Organized and systematic instruction designed to provide the apprentice with theoretical and technical knowledge related to the occupation; may be in classroom, occupational/industrial courses, correspondence, electronic media, or other self-study approved by the Registration Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secretary
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. Secretary of Labor or any Department official designated by the Secretary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Any measure, combination of measures, or procedure used as a basis for any decision in apprenticeship, including paper/pencil tests, performance tests, training programs, probationary periods, physical/educational/work experience requirements, informal interviews, and unscored application forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broadly defines assessment techniques relevant to selection and highlights the range of methods subject to scrutiny under part 30.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor
rubrics_metrics.description: Any person, employer, association, committee, intermediary, or organization that operates and administers an apprenticeship program in whose name the program is registered by a Registration Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards of apprenticeship
rubrics_metrics.description: Organized, written plan embodying the terms and conditions of employment, training, and supervision of one or more apprentices in a registered apprenticeship program.

rubrics_metrics.name: State (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Any of the 50 States, District of Columbia, Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, or outlying area of the United States as defined in WIOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Apprenticeship Agency (SAA)
rubrics_metrics.description: An agency of State government with responsibility and accountability for registered apprenticeship programs within the State; only a State government agency may seek recognition by OA as an SAA to register and oversee apprenticeship programs and agreements for Federal purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognition requires being properly constituted under applicable State legal authority and authorized by OA.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Apprenticeship Council
rubrics_metrics.description: Entity established to assist the SAA; ineligible for recognition as the State's Registration Agency and may only operate in an advisory capacity providing nonbinding advice and guidance to the SAA.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Apprenticeship Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategic and operational plan that is a State's application for recognition as an SAA and a 4-year strategy for the State's system of registered apprenticeship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used by OA to assess State recognition and system-wide governance; OA invites comment on benefits, feasibility, challenges, and burdens related to requiring submission/approval of such plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: State CTE Agency
rubrics_metrics.description: State board designated/created consistent with State law as the sole State government agency responsible for administration of CTE or another agency delegated authority by such board to administer Perkins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supportive services
rubrics_metrics.description: Services such as transportation, childcare, dependent care, housing, and needs-related payments necessary to enable an individual to participate and succeed in registered apprenticeship and CTE apprenticeship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and support provided by Registration Agency staff in development, revision, amendment, or processing of standards of apprenticeship or apprenticeship agreements, or advice to program sponsors to further compliance with this part or guidance from OA to an SAA on satisfying requirements of this part and part 30.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OA will continue to provide technical assistance and develop tools/templates to assist SAAs and stakeholders with understanding and complying with the proposed rule, including State Apprenticeship Plan development and labor standards compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transfer
rubrics_metrics.description: Shift of apprenticeship registration from one program to another or from one employer within a program to another employer within the same program, where there is agreement between the apprentice and affected apprenticeship committee or program sponsors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Underserved communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Persons from historically marginalized communities or populations adversely affected by persistent discrimination, inequality, or poverty, including (but not limited to) women; persons of color (Black, Latino, Indigenous, Asian American, Native Hawaiian, Pacific Islander); individuals with disabilities; persons adhering to particular religious beliefs; veterans and military spouses; LGBTQ+ persons; and individuals with barriers to employment as defined in WIOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regulation emphasizes ensuring equitable apprenticeship opportunities for these communities.
